response.justification: Bogdan is an excellent fit with 16+ years of fullstack development experience significantly exceeding the 6+ year requirement. His current role at re:cinq is perfectly aligned—working as Staff Software Engineer on AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and fullstack TypeScript/Node.js development. He demonstrates strong expertise across the required stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, Docker, AWS) and has proven architecture capabilities. Primary gaps are lack of explicit Nest.js and specific testing framework mention (Vitest/Jest/Playwright), plus no explicit security/auth focus, but these are readily addressable given his solid fundamentals and testing-first mindset.
strengths: Current Staff engineer role at re:cinq directly aligned: actively developing AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and fullstack features with TypeScript and Node.js

Extensive experience across required technologies: 16+ years spanning frontend (React, Ember.js), backend (Node.js, Java), databases (MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL), and cloud/containers (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes)

Proven architecture and software craftsmanship: designed microservices handling millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby, built custom testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), and demonstrates TDD and CI/CD practices
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience mentioned, though strong TypeScript and Node.js foundation provides solid foundation to quickly learn it
Specific testing frameworks (Jest, Vitest, Playwright) not explicitly listed despite demonstrated testing expertise and custom framework development
Authentication, authorization, and security best practices not explicitly highlighted, which are listed as required technical skills
